findings.message:
Do not classify every out-of-Date-range RFC-850 value as unrepresentable

When `observedAt` is a safe integer outside JavaScript Date's range, this branch marks every RFC-850-shaped header unrepresentable before validating its captured date fields. A malformed value such as an invalid time then suppresses the documented secondary-limit fallback, instead of being classified as malformed. Validate the date parts first; only a valid date that cannot be represented should return `unrepresentable`.

src/github/rate-limit.ts:195-196

summary: RFC-850 malformed hints can incorrectly suppress secondary fallback at the supported timestamp boundary.
